narrator.name: George
narrator.why: use_case: narrative_story — warm British storyteller voice. The tutorial register wants an unhurried, cozy narrator that can sell sensory food-writing (foaming butter, mahogany crust). George reads warm without performing.

mara.name: Matilda
mara.why: Mara is the meticulous one — temperature numbers, declarative sentences, dry but affectionate. Matilda's 'knowledgeable upbeat American' reads as the precise science-nerd voice without being clinical.

theo.name: Chris
theo.why: Theo is the enthusiastic one — big laughs, half-formed declarations, calls things by pet-name. Chris's 'charming, down-to-earth' captures the easy grinning warmth without forcing brashness.
